lines.en: label dormwartwo15:
scene clearnightsky
Only a handful of girls wind up coming to the next competition, but it’s not because none of them want to.
lines.zh: 最终只有寥寥几个女孩来参加下一场比赛，但这并不是因为其他人不想来。

lines.en: Yasu’s insistence that only a small group follow her to the church led to the sudden fragmentation of our class- like it’s no more than some undisclosed ingredient on an ethereal cutting board.
lines.zh: Yasu 坚持只让一小队人跟她去教堂，导致我们这个班骤然碎裂——仿佛它不过是空灵砧板上某种未公开的食材。

lines.en: Each press of the knife slices away not only our bodies, but what those bodies lie on.
lines.zh: 刀每压下一次，切开的就不只是我们的躯体，还有这些躯体所依附的东西。

lines.en: And before we know it, the fragments spread out, forever being stripped of the only opportunity they’ll ever have to be attached to anything.
lines.zh: 不知不觉间，碎块四散开来，永远被剥夺了唯一一次能依附于某物的机会。

lines.en: I’m not saying that’s what will happen tonight. Doing so would be a bit overdramatic.
lines.zh: 我不是说今晚会变成那样。这么说未免太夸张了。

lines.en: But that doesn’t stop me from thinking about what would happen if it did.
lines.zh: 可这并不妨碍我去想，如果真变成那样会怎样。

lines.en: And which pieces I would reach for first if they all started falling away at once.
lines.zh: 以及如果它们全都同时剥落，我会先伸手去抓哪几块。

lines.en: scene specialsky
Rin. Sana. Otoha. Touka. Imani.
lines.zh: Rin。Sana。Otoha。Touka。Imani。

lines.en: At the behest of Yasu, this is all that remains of our once spectacular group as the rest is off celebrating and thinking about me. Celebrating while thinking about me. Thinking ABOUT ME while CELEBRATING.
lines.zh: 在 Yasu 的要求下，我们曾经那个了不起的团体如今只剩下这些，其余的人都在别处庆祝，同时想着我。一边庆祝，一边想着我。一边想着我，一边庆祝。

lines.en: I learned a long time ago that one of the most effective methods to make yourself feel more human is to always put yourself first.
lines.zh: 很久以前我就明白，让自己感觉更像个人的最有效方法之一，就是永远把自己放在第一位。

lines.en: If you can’t find yourself, just latch onto whatever is closest.
lines.zh: 如果找不到自己，就抓住离你最近的东西。

lines.en: And in this case, the closest thing I can find to the way I feel is a handful of semi-intangible thoughts, slipping through my fingers like long, red hair with bits of scalp still attached.
lines.zh: 而眼下，最能贴近我此刻感受的，是一把半无形的思绪，它们从指缝间滑走，像还沾着几片头皮的红色长发。

lines.en: If I squint my eyes, I can forget what they are.
lines.zh: 只要我把眼睛眯起来，就能忘记它们是什么。

lines.en: I can make them look more like threads.
lines.zh: 我可以让它们看起来更像丝线。

lines.en: scene theskythationcesaw
{b}THIS IS THE WRONG SKY.{/b}
lines.zh: {b}这是错误的天空。{/b}

lines.en: scene testofsenseiofsenseiof1
: Stop.
lines.zh: : 停下。

lines.en: : What? Why? Is there, like...mass going on or something?
lines.zh: : 什么？为什么？里面是不是……在做弥撒什么的？

lines.en: : In fact, why are we even here in the first place? Couldn’t we have just done this trivia thing at Sana’s bar or whatever?
lines.zh: : 说起来，我们一开始到底为什么要来这儿？这种问答比赛在 Sana 的酒吧之类的地方办不就行了吗？

lines.en: : Yasu was adamant that the contest would have to be here for her to have any sort of chance against Rin. And Rin agreed to the terms as she already had a sizable handicap.
lines.zh: : Yasu 坚持认为，比赛必须在这里举行，她才有机会对抗 Rin。而 Rin 因为本就握有相当大的优势，便答应了这个条件。

lines.en: : Is that what happened? Because I’ve started just saying whatever it is that I think will make Yasu go away the fastest and I don’t even know what I’m agreeing to half the time.
lines.zh: : 是这样吗？因为我现在已经变成——觉得什么能让 Yasu 最快消失就说什么，有一半时间我根本不知道自己同意了什么。

lines.en: : I...should try that strategy sometime...
lines.zh: : 我……什么时候也该试试这招……

lines.en: : Just let us in and we can be quiet until mass is over or something. Being...wherever the Hell we are right now is giving me the creeps.
lines.zh: : 让我们进去吧，弥撒结束之前我们可以不出声什么的。待在……这个鬼地方让我浑身发毛。

lines.en: : {i}Where you are{/i} is the front porch of salvation...a place that you would not be able to see at all if it were not for two and a half of us.
lines.zh: : {i}你们所在之处{/i}，是救赎的门廊……若不是因为我们中的两个半人，你们根本看不见这个地方。

lines.en: : Uhh...what?
lines.zh: : 呃……什么？

lines.en: : If that’s...a short-joke...I’m going to be sad...
lines.zh: : 如果那是……在拿身高开玩笑……我会很伤心的……

lines.en: scene testofsenseiofsenseiof2
: You have any idea what’s going on right now, Senpai?
lines.zh: : 你知道现在是怎么回事吗，前辈？

lines.en: : I never have any idea what’s going on when I come here.
lines.zh: : 每次来这儿，我从来都不知道是怎么回事。

lines.en: : You a regular? Didn’t take you as the religious type.
lines.zh: : 你是常客？没看出来你还是信教的那类人。

lines.en: : I’m not. I probably just come here because I’m worried that Yasu’s going to hurt herself or something.
lines.zh: : 我不是。我大概只是因为担心 Yasu 会伤到自己什么的，才一直来这儿。

lines.en: : Probably?
lines.zh: : 大概？

lines.en: : It’s complicated.
lines.zh: : 说来话长。

lines.en: scene testofsenseiofsenseiof3
: Well, whatever it is, I can’t say I feel comfortable over here. In fact, if it was anybody other than Yasu leading all of us to this place, I’d probably be fearing for my life right about now.
lines.zh: : 唉，不管怎样，我在这儿可说不上自在。事实上，如果不是 Yasu 带我们来这种地方，换作别人，我这会儿大概已经在担心自己小命不保了。

lines.en: : I have no idea how it being Yasu makes you {i}more{/i} comfortable about that, but you do you.
lines.zh: : 我不明白为什么是 Yasu 反而让你{i}更{/i}放心，不过你开心就好。

lines.en: : Yasu’s not out to hurt anybody, I don’t think. She clearly believes all of this crap, yeah- but false beliefs are totally common in people who aren’t exactly, uhh...the same as the rest of us.
lines.zh: : 我觉得 Yasu 没打算伤害任何人。她显然是真心信这些玩意儿的——不过错误的信念在那些，呃……和我们不太一样的人身上，本来就挺常见的。

lines.en: : What if her god told her to kill us? Since she’s such a fanatic...she’d have to oblige, right?
lines.zh: : 可要是她的神叫她杀了我们呢？既然她这么狂热……她总得服从吧？

lines.en: scene testofsenseiofsenseiof4
: Oh, come on, man! You have any idea how long it’s been since I’ve practiced Krav Maga? I ain’t ready to fight for my life tonight! I just wanted to judge a contest!
lines.zh: : 拜托，老兄！你知道我多久没练过马伽术了吗？我今晚可没准备好拼命！我只是想来当个评委而已！

lines.en: : No one will be judging anything.
lines.zh: : 谁也当不成评委。

lines.en: scene testofsenseiofsenseiof5
: It is He and He alone who bestows judgement on all there is to be judged. And stepping into His sanctum just to tread all over His toes is not welcome.
lines.zh: : 唯有祂、唯有祂自己，才对一切该被审判之物降下审判。而踏入祂的圣所、只为踩遍祂的脚趾，是不受欢迎的。

lines.en: : Wait...you’re not forfeiting, are you?
lines.zh: : 等等……你不是要弃权吧？

lines.en: : All I am doing is protecting that which I have been ordained to protect. The contest will proceed as normal within the walls of the holy.
lines.zh: : 我所做的，只是保护我被指派去保护的东西。比赛会在神圣的墙壁之内照常进行。

lines.en: : But only four of us will enter while the rest of you remain out here.
lines.zh: : 但我们之中只有四人可以进去，其余的人留在外面。

lines.en: : But why-
lines.zh: : 可是为什么——

lines.en: : Because you are not ready.
lines.zh: : 因为你们还没准备好。

lines.en: : His is a church that welcomes all, but only after certain conditions have been met. It is only then that one is chosen.
lines.zh: : 祂的教堂欢迎所有人，但只有在特定条件被满足之后。唯有到那时，人才会被选中。

lines.en: : I’m confused. I thought {i}I{/i} was the only one who was chosen. Now two more people have been chosen as well?
lines.zh: : 我糊涂了。我还以为只有{i}我{/i}一个人被选中了。现在又多了两个被选中的人？

lines.en: : You do not understand the choices being {i}made.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你不明白正在{i}做出的{/i}选择。

lines.en: : Well, you’ve certainly got that much right.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这点你倒是说对了。

lines.en: : Who are the four, Yasu? I assume that you, Sensei, and Rin are among the three....But which of us apart from that is the fourth?
lines.zh: : 那四个人是谁，Yasu？我猜你、老师和 Rin 是其中三个……但在我们之外，谁是第四个？

lines.en: : She with the silly, green helmet.
lines.zh: : 那个戴着傻乎乎绿色头盔的人。

lines.en: scene testofsenseiofsenseiof6
: Why Sana? What do the rest of us need to do to...fulfill your god’s conditions or whatever?
lines.zh: : 为什么是 Sana？我们剩下的这些人要怎么做……才能满足你那个神的条件什么的？

lines.en: : All that you can do is unintentional. There is no single method that will allow you inside of the sanctuary.
lines.zh: : 你们能做的都是无意为之。没有任何一种单一的方法能让你们进入圣所。

lines.en: : My feet will allow me inside of the sanctuary a lot better than weird religious riddles will, I’ll tell you that much.
lines.zh: : 我这两条腿可比什么古怪的宗教谜语更能让我进到圣所里，这点我倒是能打包票。

lines.en: : Yasu, please explain this in a more concrete way so that those of us remaining outside do not become disheartened. I’m sure you must understand this comes as a bit of a shock to us after the long ride here.
lines.zh: : Yasu，请你用更具体的方式解释一下，免得我们这些留在外面的人灰心。你一定明白，在坐了这么久的车之后才听到这种事，对我们来说是相当大的冲击。

lines.en: : I...will swap with Otoha and...stay out here...if that’s okay...
lines.zh: : 我……可以和 Otoha 换一下……留在外面吗……如果可以的话……

lines.en: scene testofsenseiofsenseiof7
: It is not. He wants you to observe...to peer into His splendor with your brand new eyes and throw yourself deeper into a life full of patience and understanding.
lines.zh: : 不行。祂要你观看……用你那双崭新的眼睛凝视祂的荣光，并把自己更深地投入充满耐心与理解的人生。

lines.en: : And unfortunately there is no “concrete way” of explaining this as the rumbling of the surface has already formed far too many cracks on these hallowed grounds.
lines.zh: : 遗憾的是，这件事没有「具体的解释方式」，因为地表的震动早已在这片圣地之上裂开了太多缝隙。

lines.en: : Every crack you step on will be met with tragedy. And it is only I who can properly guide those who have been selected to-
lines.zh: : 你踩上的每一道裂缝都会招来悲剧。而只有我能恰当地引导那些被选中的人——

lines.en: : Oh, fucking whatever. Just go in there and get this shit over with if you’re not going to let us in.
lines.zh: : 哦，随你他妈的便。既然不让我们进去，那就进去把这破事儿赶紧办完。

lines.en: : Hey, I...know I may have {i}accidentally{/i} agreed to this to give you a fair shot, but...is there any way I can give you a fair shot {i}outside{/i} of a mega creepy church that I can't bring my girlfriend into?
lines.zh: : 嘿，我……知道我可能是{i}不小心{/i}答应了这些，好给你一个公平的机会，但是……有没有什么办法，能让我在这座超级阴森、连我女朋友都带不进去的教堂{i}之外{/i}，给你一个公平的机会？

lines.en: scene testofsenseiofsenseiof8

lines.zh: : 没有……

lines.en: : You waited too long to ask.
lines.zh: : 你问得太晚了。

lines.en: : By now, His tendrils are already wrapped around your legs.
lines.zh: : 此刻，祂的触须已经缠上了你的双腿。

lines.en: : It is only a matter of time until you’re pulled in.
lines.zh: : 你被拉进去只是时间问题。

lines.en: : Alas...it is now {i}you{/i} who does not have a {i}fair shot...{/i}
lines.zh: : 唉……如今没有{i}公平机会{/i}的人，反倒{i}是你{/i}了……

lines.en: : But...
lines.zh: : 不过……

lines.en: : At least you will learn how misguided...how {i}small{/i} you truly are...
lines.zh: : 至少你会明白自己有多么误入歧途……{i}有多么渺小{/i}……

lines.en: scene black
Reluctantly and hesitantly, those of us who have been chosen (Which apparently has multiple meanings now) follow Yasu through the church doors.
lines.zh: 我们这些被选中者（显然这个词现在有了多重含义）不情不愿、犹犹豫豫地跟着 Yasu 穿过教堂的大门。

lines.en: scene testofsenseiofsenseiof9
There are no tables or tea cups...bunnies or blindfolds...just the same sets of stone pews I have familiarized myself with in a place where nothing should ever be familiar at all.
lines.zh: 没有桌子，也没有茶杯……没有兔女郎，也没有眼罩……只有那一排排我再熟悉不过的石头长椅——在一个本不该有任何熟悉之物的地方。

lines.en: : Wow...
: It looks...a lot bigger on the inside...
lines.zh: : 里面看起来……比外面大好多……

lines.en: : Is it just me, or...is it kind of hard to breathe in here?
lines.zh: : 只有我这么觉得吗，还是说……这里面有点呼吸困难？

lines.en: : Blessed be those who enter the church...Who walk through His heart...Partake in His search...
lines.zh: : 愿祝福归于那些踏入教堂的人……那些穿过祂心脏的人……参与祂的搜寻的人……

lines.en: : Blessed be those who now have been found...Who don’t know they need saving...Who can’t hear the sounds...
lines.zh: : 愿祝福归于如今已被寻见的人……那些不知道自己需要被拯救的人……那些听不见那些声音的人……

lines.en: : We are with you, My Lord. Peer into us so that we may peer into you and blind ourselves with the light of all that you have done.
lines.zh: : 我们与您同在，我的主。凝视我们，好让我们也能凝视您，并被您一切作为的光灼瞎双眼。

lines.en: : I have brought these girls here today with the full intention of giving them wings...though, how long it will take, I am not sure.
lines.zh: : 今天我把这些女孩带到这里，满心只想给她们一双翅膀……尽管需要多久，我也不确定。

lines.en: : The light of the one who has seen you will one day flow through them. And when that time comes, we will return here under a different pretense.
lines.zh: : 那位见过您的存在之光，终有一天会流经她们。而当时刻来临，我们会以另一种名义回到这里。

lines.en: : Under a different sky.
lines.zh: : 在另一片天空下。

lines.en: : But today, all I wish is for them to see your glory. All I wish is for them to see how wonderful you are and how expansive the world is once you close your eyes.
lines.zh: : 但今天，我唯一的愿望是让她们看见您的荣光。我唯一的愿望是让她们看见您是何等美妙，以及只要闭上眼睛，这个世界就有多么辽阔。

lines.en: : I do not {i}ask{/i} this of you, God- for I know that it is not within my right nor my power to ask for anything.
lines.zh: : 我并不向您{i}祈求{/i}这些，我的神——因为我知道，我既无权利也无力量去索求任何东西。

lines.en: : But I trust that you will show them through me. And that they will understand they, too, are just vessels beneath the layers of flesh and muscle and bone.
lines.zh: : 但我相信，您会借着我向她们显现。而她们终会明白，在层层血肉、肌肉与骨骼之下，她们也不过是器皿。

lines.en: scene testofsenseiofsenseiof10
: I understand that everything hurts, God.
lines.zh: : 我明白一切都令人痛苦，我的神。

lines.en: : But I pray that the pain of this realization will not be too great for them to bear.
lines.zh: : 但我祈求，这份领悟带来的痛楚，不会沉重到她们无法承受。

lines.en: : I really don’t like this, Sensei. You know that feeling you get when you, like...sneak into school at night? Or go into some creepy basement? The one where your stomach is all like “GUHHHHH?”
lines.zh: : 我真的很不喜欢这儿，老师。你知道那种感觉吗，就是……半夜偷偷溜进学校？或者走进某个阴森的地下室？就是胃里一阵「呃——」的那种？

lines.en: : Not really.
lines.zh: : 不太知道。

lines.en: : Well, that’s how I feel right now.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我现在就是这种感觉。

lines.en: : Then forfeit before this contest thing kicks off and we can all go home. I don’t really like this place either.
lines.zh: : 那就在比赛开始前弃权吧，我们全都能回家。我也不太喜欢这地方。

lines.en: scene testofsenseiofsenseiof11
: Are you kidding? This is the perfect chance to show you that the...growing distance between us we talked about the other day is all just surface level stuff!
lines.zh: : 开玩笑吗？这可是绝佳的机会，正好能向你证明——我们那天聊起的那种……我们之间越来越远的距离，全都是表面上的东西！

lines.en: : We’re still friends, right?! We still know a bunch of stuff about each other, right?!
lines.zh: : 我们还是朋友，对吧？！我们还是了解彼此很多事情，对吧？！

lines.en: : We’re not growing apart at all! I’ll show you!
lines.zh: : 我们根本没有渐行渐远！我会证明给你看！

lines.en: : Rin-
lines.zh: : Rin——

lines.en: : I mean it! I miss you and I’m sorry that things are getting all weird between us and...also, that I’m getting randomly emotional right now for some reason?
lines.zh: : 我是认真的！我想你，也很抱歉我们之间变得这么别扭，还有……还有我现在不知道为什么突然情绪上来了？

lines.en: : I...I don’t know what’s going on! I just have to prove to everyone that we’re still homies no matter what mistakes we make or...what things we accidentally reveal to other people!
lines.zh: : 我……我不知道这是怎么回事！我就是得向所有人证明，不管我们犯了什么错，或者……不小心向别人透露了什么，我们都还是好哥们！
: Rin……我……

lines.en: : What did you-
lines.zh: : 你刚才——

lines.en: : Nothing! I’m sorry! I love you! But, like...friend love! Okay?
lines.zh: : 没什么！对不起！我爱你！不过是……朋友之间的那种爱！好吗？

lines.en: scene testofsenseiofsenseiof12
: Rin, I...think we should start the contest now. I’m also...starting to feel a little...weird in here...
lines.zh: : Rin，我……想我们该开始比赛了。我也……开始觉得在这儿有点……不对劲……

lines.en: : It’s not like it’s...harder to breathe, though...it’s more like...uhh...
lines.zh: : 不过不是那种……呼吸困难……更像是……呃……

lines.en: : Actually, let’s just...uhh...
lines.zh: : 其实，我们就……呃……

lines.en: : I think I...have to sit down...
lines.zh: : 我想我……得坐下来……

lines.en: scene black
Sana darts past Rin and me before taking a seat on a pew and slapping her cheeks a few times to shake off whatever it is she was feeling moments ago.
lines.zh: Sana 从我和 Rin 身边快步掠过，在长椅上坐下，拍了几下自己的脸颊，想甩掉方才那种不知名的感受。

lines.en: And while I’m not sure if it actually {i}works{/i} or not, I elect to assume it does once she pulls her phone from the waistband of her skirt and begins to search for something...
lines.zh: 虽然我不确定这招是否真的{i}有效{/i}，但当她从裙腰里掏出手机、开始翻找什么的时候，我选择相信它有效……

lines.en: scene testofsenseiofsenseiof13
: Um...so...we had Ami come up with all of the questions for the Sensei...knowledge test...thing, since...she’s the one who’s known him the longest.
lines.zh: : 嗯……那个……这场……老师知识测验……的题目，是我们让 Ami 出的，因为……她是认识他最久的人。

lines.en: True...but I can’t see how that’ll help when I barely know anything about myself that {i}I{/i} wasn’t here to figure out firsthand.
lines.zh: 确实……可我连自己身上那些不是{i}我{/i}亲身到场才弄清楚的事都知之甚少，真看不出这能帮上什么忙。

lines.en: If there are any questions about anything prior to my start in Kumon-mi, I won’t be able to determine who’s right or not. And without Ami here, I can’t see how we could even-
lines.zh: 如果有任何关于我来到 Kumon-mi 之前的问题，我根本判断不了谁对谁错。而 Ami 又不在这儿，我甚至看不出我们该怎么——

lines.en: Wait. No. Why would there be any questions about things from before Rin and I even knew one another? If Ami knows anything about me, she should know I don’t open up about things like that.
lines.zh: 等等。不对。怎么会有关于我和 Rin 认识之前的问题呢？如果 Ami 真的了解我，她该知道我是不会对那种事敞开心扉的。

lines.en: So...these should all be fairly straightforward questions, shouldn’t they?
lines.zh: 所以……这些题目应该都相当直白吧？

lines.en: A strange feeling catches up to me as well.
lines.zh: 一种奇怪的感觉也追上了我。

lines.en: It doesn’t involve breathing.
lines.zh: 它和呼吸无关。

lines.en: But it does make it harder to breathe.
lines.zh: 但它确实让呼吸变得更困难了。

lines.en: : I think...umm...the easiest thing to do would be...to have you two take turns answering...
lines.zh: : 我想……嗯……最简单的做法是……让你们两个轮流回答……

lines.en: : And if both of you have the same answer...we can just...move on to the next question.
lines.zh: : 如果两个人的答案一样……我们就……跳到下一题。

lines.en: : Whoever gets...ten correct answers first...will be crowned the winner...
lines.zh: : 谁先答对……十题……就是赢家……

lines.en: : Is...Is that okay?
lines.zh: : 这样……这样可以吗？

lines.en: : Yes.
lines.zh: : 可以。

lines.en: scene testofsenseiofsenseiof14
: Rin?
lines.zh: : Rin？

lines.en: : Huh? Oh! Yeah. Yeah, that’s fine.
lines.zh: : 啊？哦！行。行，没问题。

lines.en: : Then...I guess we’ll have you go first since...I’m suddenly the one in charge of this contest...
lines.zh: : 那么……我想就由你先来吧，因为……我突然成了这场比赛的负责人……

lines.en: scene black
scene testofsenseiofsenseiof15
: We can start off with something that...looks easy...
lines.zh: : 我们可以先从看起来……简单的开始……

lines.en: : Oh. This one works...
lines.zh: : 哦。这题可以……

lines.en: : How old is Sensei?
lines.zh: : 老师多大了？

lines.en: : 31. Easy. Next question.
lines.zh: : 31。简单。下一题。

lines.en: : Wait...you have to give Yasu a chance to answer...
lines.zh: : 等等……你得给 Yasu 回答的机会……

lines.en: scene testofsenseiofsenseiof16
: Yasu...same question...
lines.zh: : Yasu……同样的问题……

lines.en: : How old is Sensei?
lines.zh: : 老师多大了？

lines.en: : Yasu?...
lines.zh: : Yasu？……

lines.en: : I’m sorry...there seems to be...some sort of problem.
lines.zh: : 抱歉……似乎……出了点问题。

lines.en: : There is an answer in my head...but there is no way it can be accurate. That wouldn’t make sense.
lines.zh: : 我脑子里有一个答案……但它绝不可能是对的。那说不通。

lines.en: : Do you...want to guess anyway?...
lines.zh: : 你……要不要猜猜看？……

lines.en: : Ya-
: No.
: No...I will not answer this question. It is most assuredly some sort of mistake.
lines.zh: : 不……我不会回答这个问题。这肯定是某种错误。

lines.en: : Is having so many people inside of the church the cause of some sort of disturbance in-
lines.zh: : 教堂里一下子进来这么多人，是不是造成了某种干扰——

lines.en: : Okay, next question! Let’s keep this shit going so we can get out of here.
lines.zh: : 行了，下一题！赶紧把这破事推进完，我们好离开这儿。

lines.en: scene testofsenseiofsenseiof15
: Um...who does...Sensei love more than anyone in the world?...
lines.zh: : 嗯……老师在这个世界上……最爱的人是谁？……

lines.en: : Am I guessing the answer Ami wrote? Or the actual answer?
lines.zh: : 我猜的是 Ami 写的答案？还是真正的答案？

lines.en: : Probably...the actual answer...but they might be the same, so...
lines.zh: : 大概……是真正的答案吧……不过也可能是一样的，所以……

lines.en: : Sexual love? Or {i}love{/i} love?
lines.zh: : 是性爱那种爱？还是{i}真心爱上{/i}那种爱？

lines.en: : I...really hope it means {i}love{/i} love...otherwise...
lines.zh: : 我……真希望是{i}真心爱上{/i}那种……不然的话……

lines.en: : That was a trick question. Sensei doesn’t believe in {i}love{/i} love. Which means that it defaults to sexual love, which makes the answer...
lines.zh: : 这是个陷阱题。老师根本不相信{i}真心爱上{/i}这回事。那就默认归到性爱那类，所以答案是……

lines.en: : Uta-chan!
lines.zh: : Uta 酱！

lines.en: : Correct.
lines.zh: : 答对了。

lines.en: scene testofsenseiofsenseiof17
: Is it?...
: I had a different answer for that question as well.
lines.zh: : 这一题我的答案也不一样。

lines.en: : What...was your answer, Yasu?...
lines.zh: : 你的答案……是什么，Yasu？……

lines.en: : I’m being told...that I shouldn’t say it...
lines.zh: : 有人告诉我……不该说出来……

lines.en: : That bad things will come if I say it...
lines.zh: : 说出来的话，会有坏事降临……

lines.en: : How unfortunate. I suppose I will have to pass on this question as well.
lines.zh: : 真是遗憾。看来这一题我也只能弃权了。

lines.en: scene testofsenseiofsenseiof18
: Alright, hit me again! I’m starting to get fired up!
lines.zh: : 好，再来！我开始上头了！

lines.en: : Earth to Sana! I said hit me again!
lines.zh: : Sana，听到没有！我说再来一题！

lines.en: : Oh! Sorry...I just...there's a page full of questions labeled “hard” and I was...looking at all of the answers myself.
lines.zh: : 哦！抱歉……我只是……有一整页标着「困难」的题目，我刚才……自己在看那些答案。

lines.en: : Don’t just peer into my background like that. That's an invasion of privacy, isn't it?
lines.zh: : 别就这么窥探我的底细啊。这算侵犯隐私吧？

lines.en: : S-Sorry! I’ve just...never really thought of...asking any of this stuff, and...and it’s...making me feel a little closer to you, since...you never tell me anything...
lines.zh: : 对、对不起！我只是……从来没想过……问这些事情，而且……而且这让我……觉得和你近了一点，因为……你从来什么也不告诉我……

lines.en: : Then it’s a good thing you’re not the one up here! Leave those “hard” questions to Sensei’s self-proclaimed best friend, Rin Rokuhara. What’s next?
lines.zh: : 那还好站在上面答题的人不是你！这些「困难」题就交给老师自称的挚友 Rin Rokuhara 吧。下一题是什么？

lines.en: : Uhh...okay, then...
lines.zh: : 呃……那好吧……

lines.en: : Before Sensei was a teacher...he did something else...what was it?
lines.zh: : 在老师当老师之前……他做的是别的工作……是什么？

lines.en: scene testofsenseiofsenseiof19
: Oh, I don’t think he’s told me this. But I remember Noriko saying something about it once and...
lines.zh: : 哦，这个他好像没跟我说过。不过我记得 Noriko 有一次提过，然后……

lines.en: : He was a...tutor wasn’t he? Or a babysitter or something?
lines.zh: : 他是……家教吧？还是保姆什么的？

lines.en: : He was a tutor. That is correct.
lines.zh: : 他做过家教。回答正确。

lines.en: : Sensei?
lines.zh: : 老师？

lines.en: : Yeah...they both got it right.
lines.zh: : 嗯……她们两个都答对了。

lines.en: Though that’s essentially all I know about the subject matter.
lines.zh: 不过关于这件事，我基本上也就知道这么多了。

lines.en: : Then...as a follow-up question...where did Sensei do that?...
lines.zh: : 那么……作为追问……老师是在哪里做家教的？……

lines.en: scene testofsenseiofsenseiof20
: Uhh...I don’t know. House calls? Coffee shops? Maybe he-
lines.zh: : 呃……我不知道。上门？咖啡厅？也许他——

lines.en: scene testofsenseiofsenseiof21
: Heheh...
lines.zh: : 呵呵……

lines.en: : Huh? You don’t actually know, do you? Because you didn’t even know his age.
lines.zh: : 嗯？你其实不知道吧？毕竟你连他几岁都不知道。

lines.en: : There are several answers to that question.
lines.zh: : 这个问题有好几个答案。

lines.en: : Two of which are very naughty.
lines.zh: : 其中两个非常下流。

lines.en: : But the one that’s likely written down is...
lines.zh: : 但最可能被写下来的那个是……

lines.en: : Well, I suppose it’s safe to just call it a storefront in the old district now.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我想现在把它称作旧城区的一间店面，应该没错了。

lines.en: : Though, it was quite different back when it was used for...{i}educational{/i} purposes.
lines.zh: : 不过，在它还在被用于……{i}教育{/i}用途的时候，情形可是大不相同。

lines.en: : Uh...well, all it says here is “building in old district” so...I think Yasu gets a point for that.
lines.zh: : 呃……嗯，这上面只写了「旧城区的建筑」，所以……我觉得这题算 Yasu 得分。

lines.en: scene testofsenseiofsenseiof22
: Seriously? But that’s so vague...I didn’t realize we could just guess a district and say “Oh, it’s some building there.”
lines.zh: : 真的假的？可这也太含糊了……我不知道还能只猜个城区，然后说「哦，就是那儿的一栋楼」。

lines.en: : Umm...what do you think, Sensei?...Should we give Yasu a point? Or...
lines.zh: : 嗯……你觉得呢，老师？……这题要给 Yasu 一分吗？还是……

lines.en: : I don’t see why not. I can’t imagine she’ll be getting many more since half of her answers have been cut off by poor godly reception.
lines.zh: : 我觉得可以。反正她大概也拿不到几分了，毕竟她有一半的答案都被糟糕的神谕信号切断了。

lines.en: : Ugh...fine. Whatever. Just give me the next question.
lines.zh: : 呃……行吧。随便。给我下一题。

lines.en: : Okay...Here’s another “hard” one so...you can try to redeem yourself...
lines.zh: : 好……这是另一道「困难」题，这样……你可以试着挽回一局……

lines.en: : Rin...
lines.zh: : Rin……

lines.en: : What is the name...
lines.zh: : 名字是……

lines.en: : Of Sensei’s mother?...
lines.zh: : 老师的母亲叫什么？……

lines.en: scene testofsenseiofsenseiof23
: You have a mother?
lines.zh: : 你有母亲？

lines.en: : Doesn’t...everyone have a mother?
lines.zh: : 不是……每个人都有母亲吗？

lines.en: : I guess. I’ve just never heard him talk about her before.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。我只是从没听他提过她。

lines.en: : In fact, the one time I tried asking about that, he-
lines.zh: : 事实上，我有一次想问这件事，他——

lines.en: : Saki.
lines.zh: : Saki。

lines.en: scene testofsenseiofsenseiof24
: Huh?
scene testofsenseiofsenseiof25
: His mother's name was Saki...
lines.zh: : 他母亲的名字是 Saki……

lines.en: : She didn’t like him very much.
lines.zh: : 她不太喜欢他。
